title: Grateful Dead Live at Henry J. Kaiser Convention Center on 1986-12-30
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz) >KORG AudioGate 4 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Solid soundboard capture of a lively 12/30/86 show, highlighted by Jerry’s fiery playing and a stronger second set.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise the performance, noting that Jerry Garcia is “back with a vengeance” and that the second set delivers the “honey” of an ’80s Dead concert. The Miller soundboard recording is described as “very nice” for the era, offering a clear enough listening experience despite the vintage source.

ai_rating.rationale: Two consistent 4‑star reviews emphasize strong musical performance and decent soundboard quality, leading to a solid overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note the recording is “very nice for an 80's show” and commend Charlie Miller’s work, indicating clear enough sound despite the era.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set 1 has decent moments, but Set 2 is highlighted as the stronger half of the concert.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as “back with a vengeance” and delivering strong, fiery playing.
